reason: I feed four cats at home plus the strays outside, so I count every sen per meal. RM 2.80 a pouch is more than I pay for Whiskas, and nothing here tells me why a brand I have never heard of is worth the extra. I would follow the page for the free pack and that is all.
objection: It costs more than Whiskas and there is no bulk pack or multi-buy price, so for my number of cats it just adds up to more money every week for a brand nobody I know has tried.
would_change_my_mind: A real bulk deal that brings a pouch to about RM 2 or less (a box of 12 or 24), or a big cheap sack of dry food, and my cats actually finishing the free pack.
